description: This file defines CLI commands for configuring and running Gmail webhook integrations within the openclaw project. It includes command registration, option parsing, and external module references related to Gmail and webhook setup.

methods.name: registerWebhooksCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands related to webhooks and Gmail integration, including setup and run commands with options parsing and execution logic.

methods.name: parseGmailSetupOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line options for setting up Gmail webhook watch and Pub/Sub configuration.

methods.name: parseGmailRunOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line options for running Gmail webhook service with auto-renew.

methods.name: parseGmailCommonOptions
methods.description: Extracts common options for Gmail commands from raw input.

methods.name: gmailOptionsFromCommon
methods.description: Converts parsed common options into Gmail-specific options for execution.

methods.name: stringOption
methods.description: Converts raw input to a trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: numberOption
methods.description: Converts raw input to a positive integer or undefined.

methods.name: booleanOption
methods.description: Converts raw input to a boolean value.
